title: Establish Project Structure and Core Types
description: Initialize the project directory structure, configure TypeScript/ESM build settings, and define immutable core types and interfaces for the game engine (Vector2D, GameObject, GameState, InputState). Include unit tests validating immutability and basic vector math.
acceptanceCriteria: Vector2D operations return new immutable instances without mutating operands
TypeScript compilation succeeds with zero errors
reviewFeedback: The code changes successfully fulfill the requirements of TASK-001. Vector2D enforces immutability via Object.freeze and returns new instances on operations. Core types and interfaces are well-defined with proper readonly modifiers, and comprehensive unit tests cover math operations, error handling, and type structures.
